detail: ticket 2: first merge passed, 0 merge failure(s), 9 steps; recall showed 8 fact(s)

memories_after: [Fact] Project settings for the docs project are stored in agenium.toml at the worktree root (project id, name, key_prefix, main_branch, template, checks, network allowlist); currently the [checks] pre_merge value and the network allowlist are empty, so no configured check is present in the worktree config itself.
[Fact] In the docs project worktree, reports/ does not exist initially and is created on first write of a report file, showing up as untracked in git status.
[Fact] In the docs project, writing file content ending in a newline via write_file produces LF-only endings with no BOM, as confirmed with Format-Hex.
[Fact] In the docs project, deliverables/hello.txt is an existing reference document that shows the ownership-line-plus-content format used for team documents.
[Lesson] The failure text of the docs pre-merge check names the exact expected first line, so read it and match it verbatim rather than guessing.
[Lesson] Verify a docs deliverables file with byte-level checks before submitting: exact case-sensitive first line match, required content still present, no BOM and LF endings.

[Lesson] When the pre-merge check rejects a docs document because the first line is wrong, prepend the exact required ownership line as line 1 while keeping the required content on the following line.
[Fact] In the docs project worktrees, verification is done with PowerShell commands such as Get-Content, Test-Path and Get-Content -Raw.
[Fact] In the docs project, team documents live in the deliverables/ and reports/ directories, as stated in the project README.
[Lesson] When creating any document under deliverables/ or reports/ in the docs project, write the first line as exactly 'Owner: docs-team' before submitting, otherwise the pre-merge check fails.
[Fact] In the docs project, every team document in deliverables/ or reports/ must have exactly 'Owner: docs-team' as its first line; the pre-merge check enforces this.
